dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent 'O' shaped structures on the mid-dorsal region exhibit sharp dark outer perimeters (pixel values <50) with a steep gradient transition into high-intensity centers (pixel values >180). Additional 'C' shaped perimeters are clustered on the mid-lateral flank, showing irregular, jagged outer boundaries.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, solid, high-intensity pixel clusters localized on the anterior-lateral neck region. These blobs lack internal gradients and are organized in a vertically aligned, nearly parallel series of five distinct points.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli form a scalene triangle with the longest side oriented along the longitudinal axis. Connecting the centroids of the five high-intensity blobs on the neck creates a nearly linear vertical path with approximately equal spacing between nodes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, localized region of low-intensity red and high-intensity white pixels, indicating exposed tissue or a raw lesion, is visible on the distal portion of the posterior flipper. A series of parallel, linear, high-contrast indentations are visible on the lateral neck area.
other_distinctive_markers: The 'ladder-like' geometric arrangement of parallel scars on the anterior region represents a unique morphological pattern distinct from the circular texture of the rest of the hide.
